paragraphs.text: Because God promised to deliver them, not for their sakes, but for his Name, Isa 48:11, therefore they ground their prayer on this promise.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: When the wicked see that God does not always accomplish his promise as they imagined, they think there is no God.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: No impediments can slow his work, but he uses even the impediments to serve his will.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Seeing that neither the matter nor the form can commend their idols it follows that there is no reason that they should be esteemed.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: He shows what great vanity it is to ask help from them who not only have no help in them, but lack sense and reason.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: As much without sense as blocks and stones.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: For they were appointed by God as instructors and teachers of faith and religion for others to follow.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: That is, he will continue his graces toward his people.
paragraphs.label: h
paragraphs.anchor: will bless the house of Israel

paragraphs.text: And therefore still governs and continues all things in it.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: And they declare enough his sufficiency so that the world serves him nothing, but to show his fatherly care toward men.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: Though the dead set forth God's glory, yet he means here, that they praise him not in his Church and congregation.
paragraphs.label: l
